use: pins for the external tools the harness runs; install fetches each against its hash into runtime/tools/, a zip with `unpack` unpacked into runtime/tools/<unpack>/, holding `exe`

presentmon.why: console build; one continuous ETW session per run (measurement.md#tools); file and sha256 pinned by the Phase -1 spike (platform.md#mc-263-verified, S6)
presentmon.sha256Why: GitHub publishes no checksum for the release asset; the sha256 is of the file downloaded on 2026-10-06 (980320 bytes) and pins later installs to it

glslang.why: L0's preprocess (-E), compile and link (-l) and reflection (-q) of the pack's own source (offline.md#tools); the newest release, 2026-09-11 (plans/m3.md D58)
glslang.sha256Why: GitHub's asset digest, equal to the sha256 of the file downloaded on 2026-10-20 (13734779 bytes)

rga.printedWhy: what the unpacked rga.exe --version prints ("Radeon GPU Analyzer Version: 2.15.0.30 (10/02/2026)", 2026-10-22); check L2 holds the exe to it, so another build unpacked into rga-2.15/ is refused
rga.why: L2's command line (-s opengl -c gfx1101): registers, ISA, live registers and the CFG of dumped stages; explains, never gates (offline.md#tools); the newest release, 2026-10-06 (plans/m3.md D58)
rga.sha256Why: GitHub's asset digest, equal to the sha256 of the file downloaded on 2026-10-20 (268732151 bytes)

renderdoc.why: L4's captures and replays: renderdoc.dll injected into the debug tier by gfx-debuggers, qrenderdoc's bundled Python for attribution and pass outputs (offline.md#tools); the newest release, 2026-08-31 (plans/m4.md P7)
renderdoc.sha256Why: renderdoc.org publishes a .sig and no checksum; the sha256 is of the file downloaded on 2026-10-26 (101000153 bytes, the size renderdoc.org served that day) and pins later installs to it
